# telnyx_speech_to_text_providers (Data Source)

The speech-to-text providers and models, with their languages and the services that can use them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deepgram models that AI assistants can use. `provider_filter` is sent as
# the API's `provider` query parameter, a name Terraform reserves.
data "telnyx_speech_to_text_providers" "deepgram" {
  provider_filter = "deepgram"
  service_type    = "ai_assistant"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `provider_filter` (String) One of `assemblyai`, `azure`, `cohere`, `deepgram`, `google`, `humain`, `openai`, `parakeet`, `reson8`, `soniox`, `speechmatics`, `telnyx`, `xai`.
- `service_type` (String) Service surface a model is available on. `ai_assistant` is the STT surface configured via Call Control voice-assistant transcription; it covers both live-streaming and non-streaming/batch models (matching the `TranscriptionConfig.model` enum on `call-control` voice assistants). One of `ai_assistant`, `file_based`, `in_call`, `streaming`.

### Read-Only

- `speech_to_text_providers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--speech_to_text_providers))

<a id="nestedatt--speech_to_text_providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `speech_to_text_providers`

Read-Only:

- `hosted` (Boolean) Whether this model runs on Telnyx-hosted infrastructure (`true`) or is provided by a third-party vendor (`false`).
- `model` (String) Provider-scoped model name.
- `provider` (String) STT provider name.
- `service_types` (Attributes List) Service surfaces this (provider, model) supports. When the request filters by `service_type`, only the matching nested entry is returned for each matching model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--speech_to_text_providers--service_types))

<a id="nestedatt--speech_to_text_providers--service_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `speech_to_text_providers.service_types`

Read-Only:

- `languages` (List of String) Languages accepted on this service surface, in the provider's native code format. `auto` indicates the provider performs language detection.
- `type` (String) Service surface a model is available on. `ai_assistant` is the STT surface configured via Call Control voice-assistant transcription; it covers both live-streaming and non-streaming/batch models (matching the `TranscriptionConfig.model` enum on `call-control` voice assistants).
